plugins.name: Account Health Pushover
plugins.description: Sends Pushover alerts when Claude, Codex, or Grok (xAI) OAuth credentials require reauthentication or become credential-unhealthy, and optionally when an account's weekly quota is almost used or exhausted.
plugins.author: NoorChasib

plugins.name: Auto Baseline
plugins.description: Learns the newest authentic Claude Code and Codex CLI client fingerprint from inbound requests and promotes it into claude-header-defaults / codex-header-defaults so the proxy's measured baseline follows the client you actually run.
plugins.author: NoorChasib

plugins.name: Reset Priority
plugins.description: Prioritizes Claude and Codex OAuth accounts by the exact reset time of their regular weekly quota.
plugins.author: NoorChasib

plugins.name: Token Usage
plugins.description: Persistent CPA-reported raw token usage by provider/model. Linux amd64 only; not billing or lossless accounting.
plugins.author: NoorChasib
